entities.summary: Alexandra Susanna Rapaport is a Swedish film and stage actress. She studied at the Teaterhögskolan i Stockholm, from which she graduated in 1997. She then worked for Uppsala Theatre before becoming engaged by the Royal Dramatic Theatre in Stockholm, where she is part of the permanent ensemble and has participated a number of classic plays.
